## Body

Review #335 passed at 475a964c6bf7359b7442a56c19473a983451d91c after two rounds. For alternate harness configs, trace operator-authored env/bin/args as launch policy under C33, preserving closed grammars and shell-safe argument rendering rather than inventing per-seat isolation.

An alternate home's persistence must survive session succession as well as initial registration and revive. The /new path now inherits an alt only from a verified predecessor with the same harness and exact PID/process-start identity, without overwriting an existing alt (crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1404-1413).

Proof lesson: distinguish CI failure from watcher transport failure. The amended-head watcher exited on a GitHub API timeout, but gh run view confirmed successful CI and just pr-freeze confirmed FINAL. A dependency-free review evidence envelope could encode this distinction alongside privacy receipts and C25 CI-only TS proof. No new feature was started.
